answer: A payout is split so that 44% arrives at settlement and the rest over 12 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The reef schedule is applied in ledge and glacier reveals each instalment. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1011 identities would post 4634 proofs and burn roughly 47 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
